title: SH 114 Roanoke Main Lane Construction

pageHeader.title: SH 114 Roanoke Main Lane Construction
pageHeader.lastUpdated: Created April 18, 2023. Last updated March 6, 2026 (update project status)

text:
In April 2023 bids were opened for construction of 2 miles of main lanes west of Roanoke to east of I-35W. Low bid was $107 million.

The eastbound main lanes opened to traffic on October 30, 2025. The westbound lanes were open by the first week of November 2025.
